title: Veggie Ground-Ricotta Pita Pizza with Zucchini, Spinach & Basil

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim and small dice zucchini.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add zucchini, veggie ground, and spices. Cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until it is browned and crumbly and zucchini is tender, about 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, arrange pitas on a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the pitas are baking, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Add tomato sauce and half of the basil to the skillet with the veggie ground and zucchini, then stir to combine. (Reserve remaining basil for later use.)
Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.

Spread pitas with about ⅔ of the ricotta; top with veggie ground mixture, then dot with remaining ricotta. Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to bake until pizzas are warmed through, about 5 minutes.
When the pizzas are done, remove from the oven. Sprinkle with reserved basil and cut into wedges.
To serve, divide pizzas between plates and enjoy!
